label: monk2-s5
resisted: Nothing structural. Uneven count-2 peak (I6 weight 11.95 vs I3 5.25): 38 train false negatives at 0.5 (acc 0.890) though train AUC 1.0, logit ranking margin 0.07.
tool_bugs: apply_operation docstring gives add_identity_node params {target_node_id, connection_sources}; engine requires {target_node, connections:[[src,tgt]], new_node_id}.
rule_agreement: Ranking matches 'exactly two of six' on all 432 configurations (AUC 1.0); at 0.5 it computes 'exactly two except most pairs with a6=1 and some a2&a4 / a4&a5', 89% of 432 correct.
summary: Descending linear ramp switches the output off at >=3 first values; a single ReLU gate (node 217) fires at 0-1 and suppresses via -5.64: sigmoid(Ramp - 1.20 - 5.64 Gate), peaking at exactly two. Mirrors the paper's construction with reversed ramp.
